description: This Mendeley Data version 4 release contains a structured survey of hybrid-car adoption in Bangladesh, with 474 cleaned responses and sixty variables. The questionnaire combines demographics with five-point items about expected performance, effort, social influence, environmental concern and other adoption factors. The repository lists an Excel data workbook, a codebook and a questionnaire under CC BY 4.0, with public access and no registration requirement. The article locates respondents mainly in Dhaka and surrounding urban or semi-urban areas; a national sampling frame is not established. Cross-sectional stated intentions do not measure actual vehicle purchases or charging demand. Cleaning removed missing responses, and selection and self-reporting limit population extrapolation. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is testing behavioural adoption assumptions in road-transport or household fleet scenarios. model-simmobility is a related travel simulation resource, but no direct import or behavioural parameter fit was checked. The workbook and PDFs were not downloaded or analysed.
